# Opening source geometry and deferred render poses

`native_opening_source_model_geometry_0`, `_1` and `_2` run the actual authored
scene08 objects `dervish`, `tartarus` and `prophet_counc_01`, respectively. Each
uses a fresh original source world, the retained campaign session, original
birth, authored custom animation and original model builder. The English TU1.5
XBE SHA-256 is
`21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`.
The opening map SHA-256 is
`5093e2f8ef7f0df41c11c6621bac5785a36f78a1cff3b8b2bc6c14b561c02a28`.

The builder receives declared view0, solo, unmodified view and distance metrics
1/1. The test compares the resource-union consumer's complete ordered vertices
against the existing cache loader given the actual source object's resolved
region bank and the builder's selected LOD. Both paths receive the actual
deferred rendered WORLD pose. Counts are 6804, 9663 and 8100 vertices. Tartarus's
unseeded preview selection is unresolved, while its original live selection is
complete. Resource preparation and render readback leave source RNG unchanged.
This is an admission/geometry/pose integration check, not an independent
original decoder, shader-pixel or Xbox framebuffer comparison.

`native_opening_source_unit_controls` also consumes the selected vertices after
the authored emotional control on object56 (`regret`). Object58 is `mercy`;
older variable labels called these Truth/Regret incorrectly, while their
name indices and authored scene05 tracks were already correct. Emotional and
neutral replays start from the same world checkpoint and advance30 actual
source phases. Their rendered vertices differ. The bounded test prepares the
CPU resource union only during vertex consumption; production retains the bank
across frames. No audio, full scene VM, facial pixel or converted MCC acceptance
is inferred.

The full resource union remains available for all six LODs and every authored
permutation. Identical section lists share storage only with bit-identical
compound palettes. Original selected section order and repetitions are retained.
Shader preparation uses each section's already decoded LOD stream; it does not
decode lower LOD sections against the LOD5 palette. Per-frame skinning processes
only selected sections. No random variant, section, LOD or pose is supplied by
this resource owner.
